11-22.name: Alan Stern
11-22.blurb: American engineer and planetary scientist who led NASA's New Horizons mission, giving humanity its first close-up images of Pluto.

11-21.name: Ernst Mach
11-21.blurb: Physicist who studied shock waves and supersonic speed—which is why speeds faster than sound are measured in Mach numbers.

11-23.name: Henry Moseley
11-23.blurb: English physicist who discovered how X-rays reveal each element's atomic number, fixing the order of the periodic table.

12-09.name: Grace Hopper
12-09.blurb: Computer scientist and Navy rear admiral who built the first compiler and helped create COBOL, making code look like English.
